Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. The Afghanistan players are in a huddle. Lendl Simmons and Evin Lewis are the openers for West Indies. Mohammad Nabi to begin with the ball. Here he comes...
... The Run Chase ...

Afghanistan have the runs on the board here. But this West Indies batting lineup has the potential to chase any score if they get going. Will we finally see the Caribbean power today? Or will the Afghan bowlers defend this out? We shall find out soon, chase coming up on the other side.

The West Indian bowlers were erratic right from the start and gave away quite a few freebies to the openers. Akeal Hosein was the only bowler who managed to tie things up. Some sloppy fielding didn't help their cause. Obed McCoy, although expensive, bowled a good 19th over and gave away only six runs along with the wickets of two set batters. Andre Russell also bowled a brilliant last over giving away just 4 runs and kept the Afghans inside 200.

The Afghanistan openers started with a bang as they scored 62 runs from the Powerplay. Both the openers scored quickfire fifties as they raced away to 100 runs at the halfway mark. After the openers departed, cameos by Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Najibullah Zadran took them to a very good total in the end.
Wow! 189 on the board for Afghanistan. They will be very happy with the runs on the board but a couple of good last overs has handed a bit of momentum to West Indies.

A great over to end the innings by Andre Russell! Full-length ball, way outside off. The ball though is inside the tramline. Naib just watches the ball go past him, he regrets not going after this. AFGHANISTAN END THEIR INNINGS AT 189/5.
Length and on middle. Naib tucks it to deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Very good yorker, on middle and leg. Nabi moves across and pushes it towards long off for a single.
On a length, around off. Naib pushes it to mid on and rotates the strike for his skipper.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Afghan's stay was rather a short one. Short ball, outside off, off-pace delivery this one. Afghan stays inside the crease and looks to heave it across the line. All he manages to get is an inside edge and the ball goes on to disturb the furniture. It's been a struggling end here for Afghanistan.
Gulbadin Naib makes his way out!
Swing and a miss! Russell serves a slower one, back-of-a-length delivery, on top of off. Afghan looks to pull it away but misses.
A length ball, on off. Afghan works it to mid-wicket for a single. Can Afghanistan reach the 200-run mark?
Andre Russell to bowl the final over of the innings!
A slower full-length ball, outside off. Nabi digs it out towards point and takes a single.
FOUR! Nabi gets off the mark with a boundary and spoils the opportunity of a hat-trick. Short ball, on middle and leg. Nabi walks across the stumps and tickles it towards fine leg for a boundary.

OUT! CAUGHT! Obed McCoy gets two wickets in two deliveries. He has sent back both the set batters. A full-length ball, on off. Gurbaz stays inside the crease and looks to clear the cover fence. He lifts the ball over covers but does not find the distance on it. Hayden Walsh runs to his left from long off and takes a very good catch. He is the most reliable fielder in the West Indies camp at the moment. Has shown intensity in every game. The hat-trick ball to follow.
Commentary.Howout: c Hayden Walsh b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: Asghar Afghan is in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Akeal Hosein makes no mistake in the deep. McCoy gets his first wicket of the game. A short ball, on middle and leg. Zadran hangs back and pulls it towards deep square leg. Akeal Hosein settles under it and takes a good catch. A good knock from Zadran comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Nabi walks out!
Swing and a miss! A slower length ball, outside off. Zadran looks to heave it across the line but misses.
A length ball, on the pads. Gurbaz works it to deep square leg for a brace. 49 runs have come in the last 4 overs for Afghanistan.

DROPPED! Lendl Simmons is the culprit this time. Fuller and on off, Zadran throws his bat at it. The ball takes the top edge and goes towards sweeper cover. Lendl Simmons comes forward but looks like he misjudged the ball and lets it slip out in the end. The batters get a single.
SIX! BANG! A cracking sound comes off the bat. A full-length ball, on off. Zadran hangs back and muscles it over the long off fence. 15 runs off the over so far.
Another full-length delivery, outside off. Zadran lofts it over cover-point. The batters pick another brace. 9 runs off the first three balls. How much more will Afghanistan hurt?
Full length and outside off. Zadran slices it over extra cover. Hayden Walsh covers a lot of ground to his right from long off. The batters take two before he cuts it out.
WIDE! Full toss, way outside off. Zadran tries to connect but fails. Wide called.
WIDE! A length ball, outside off, moving away. Zadran looks to chase it but misses. Wide called.

Great effort by Lewis in the deep. He saves three runs for his team. A length ball, on middle and leg. Gurbaz hangs back and whips it across the line. For a moment it looked as if it will clear the fence, but Lewis leaps near the ropes, catches the ball and puts it back in play with a one-handed attempt. The momentum though takes him on the other side of the advertisement boards and he hurts his knees while jumping over the fence. He is down in pain.

Looks like Evin Lewis has injured himself. He went to take a catch and went over the ropes and looks to have hurt his foot near the fence. It looked like he was in some pain but he is seen limping away. Does not look too serious.
Yorker on off. Gurbaz moves back and pushes it towards mid off for a single.
WIDE! A length ball, wide outside off. Gurbaz leaves it alone. Wide called.
Slower delivery this time, on off. Gurbaz defends it out watchfully.
SIX! All the way! This time Gurbaz connects well. Full and on off. Gurbaz coves the stumps, gets under it and powers it over the wide long on fence for a maximum.
Nicely bowled! A swing and a miss for Gurbaz. A full-length ball, outside off. The ball moves away off the pitch. It was a cutter. Gurbaz looks to hit it down the ground but misses.
LEG BYE! Back of a length, on the pads. Zadran looks to flick it away but misses. The ball rolls to the leg side off the pads. They collect a leg bye.
Fuller and on off. Gurbaz pushes it to long off for a single.
A couple to end the over! Length and on off. Zardan hangs back and drives it through covers. The batters pick two runs. 13 runs off the over.
A length ball, on off. Gurbaz pushes it to covers for a single.
Length ball, outside off, Najibullah Zadran pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Outside off. Zadran looks to chase it but misses.
A length ball, on middle. nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, around off, Najibullah Zadran swings across the line but misses. Nicholas Pooran, the wicketkeeper, fails to collect it cleanly and gives away a bye.

Huge no ball again! Slower length ball, Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to pull but gets a top edge. The ball goes in the air and Oshane Thomas takes a catch but it won't matter as it was a Free Hit. Thomas fires in a throw at the end of the batter as they sneak in a run. He misses and the ball goes away towards the fine leg boundary. Sloppy from the Windies. Free Hit stays...
NO BALL! Overstepping! Length ball, on the body, Rahmanullah Gurbaz plays it back to the bowler. Free Hit coming up.
Tossed up, om middle and leg, Najibullah Zadran pushes it back to the bowler.
Najibullah Zadran looks to sweep this full ball but misses. The ball hits his pads. No damage done. Probably going down.
Fuller, Najibullah Zadran works it towards the on side for a couple.
FOUR! Najibullah Zadran reverse-sweeps this time and gets it over backward point. Kieron Pollard runs across to his right in the deep, puts in a dive but fails to cut it off.
Fuller, on the pads, Najibullah Zadran works it away towards fine leg and gets a couple.
Ohh... good ball! Googly, on middle, turning away from Najibullah Zadran. He looks to defend but the ball just misses the outside edge of his blade.
Good-length ball, around off. Zardan pushes it to the right of mid off. Hayden Walsh runs to his right and makes a half stop. The batters cross for a single. 8 runs and a wicket off it.
Back of a length, on off. Zadran sways away from the line of the delivery. Najibullah Zadran is not happy with the umpire as it's not given as a wide.
Akeal Hosein is done with the ball. Hayden Walsh (2-0-16-1) replaces him.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ravi Rampaul gets his first wicket of the game. Shahzad has done his job and he departs on 54. A length ball, outside off. Shahzad looks to guide it above the short third man fielder, but he had no pace to play with. The ball lobs straight to the fielder and Akeal Hosein pouches it safely. West Indies would look to create more inroads from hereon.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Ravi Rampaul

Commentary.Commentary: Najibullah Zadran strides out.
FOUR! Classy! Mohammad Shahzad is going to free his arms now. A full-length ball, on middle and off. Shahzad moves back and lifts it over extra cover for a boundary.

In the air...safe! A length ball, on middle and leg. Shahzad hangs back and works it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. The ball lands in a vacant area. The batters take two and Shahzad gets his half-century. A brilliant knock from him.
A full-length ball, on middle and leg. Gurbaz throws his bat at it. The ball takes the inner half and goes towards deep square leg. They take one.
Tossed up, outside off. Shahzad looks to reverse-hit it but misses. He stays on 48. A good over by Hosein, he finishes his 4-over spell - 0/25.
Ravi Rampaul is back to have a second bite of the cherry. 0/8 in his only over.
Full and on the pads. Gurbaz flicks it to wide long on and rotates the strike.
Slightly short and outside off. Shahzad moves back and cuts it through covers for a single.
Loopy ball, full and outside off. The ball moves away. Shahzad looks to chase it but misses.
Flatter and outside off. Shahzad hangs back and slashes it through covers. The batters pick two with ease. Good running here. Putting the pressure on the fielder.
Slower through the air, short and outside off. Gurbaz comes forward and pushes it to covers for a single.
Fuller length, around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz drills it to long on for a single.
Shorter length, this time, Mohammad Shahzad backs away and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Akeal Hosein to bowl out. 0/20 in his 3 overs so far.
Fuller, on the pads, Mohammad Shahzad flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs.
FOUR! The senior pro is playing a good knock here! Andre Russell delivers this short and outside the off stump, Mohammad Shahzad gets back and cuts it over backward point for a boundary.
Fuller ball, outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz drives it to long off for a single.
On a length, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller, on the pads, Rahmanullah Gurbaz clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller again, Gurbaz looks to drive but gets no timing on that one.
Andre Russell to have a go now.
SIX! Clean strike! Tossed up, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz skips down the track and launches it over long on for a biggie.
On off, fuller, Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it off the front foot towards the off side.
Another good floated delivery, on the stumps, Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets forward and blocks it.
Tossed up, on middle, Mohammad Shahzad works it away wide of long on for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Gurbaz looks to sweep it away but misses.
A single now and this brings up 100 for Afghanistan. Flatter and on middle. Shahzad defends it to the right of the bowler. Hosein misses it and the ball goes to long on. The batters take a single.

Drinks! Afghanistan have got off to a flier as they have raised 100 in the first 10 overs. Now, they would be looking to replicate the same and add another 100 runs at least in the last 10 to get to the 200-run mark. West Indies have not had the best time as their bowling and fielding have been slightly wayward. They would be aiming for a couple of quick wickets after the break.

FOUR! Streaky! It does not matter, as long as the runs keep coming. Full and on middle, Shahzad moves back and has a go at it. The ball takes the inside edge, scoots past the stumps and runs into the boundary at fine leg.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for a single.
Good turn on this one! Loopy ball, outside off, the ball spins away. Gurbaz looks to have a poke at it but misses.

EDGY! Shahzad is dealing only in a streaky manner. The luck is with him. Full and on off. Shahzad swings hard at it. The ball takes the outside edge and flies past short third man. Oshane Thomas gives it a chase and keeps it out before the boundary. The batters take three.
Akeal Hosein returns. 0/11 in his 2 overs.
Quicker. Short and on middle. Shahzad works it to long on for a single. 8 runs and a wicket off it.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hayden Walsh has the last laugh here. Zazai's brilliant knock of 56 runs comes to an end. He has built a solid foundation for his side. Floated, full and on off. Zazai gets low and looks to slog-sweep it. The ball takes the top edge and flies high in the air towards deep square leg. Evin Lewis keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Evin Lewis b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off. Skidding away. Zazai looks to go after it but misses again.
Who walks out now? It is Rahmanullah Gurbaz.
Flatter and outside off. Zazai looks to chase it but misses.
SIX! KABOOM! Zazai takes the attack straightaway on the new bowler. Full and on off, Zazai gets low and slog-sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence. It clears the man in the deep.
Floated, full and on off. Mohammad Shahzad hits it down the ground towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Fifty for Hazratullah Zazai in just 31 balls! Shorter length, around leg, Hazratullah Zazai looks to pull but gets a top edge. The ball goes over the head of the wicketkeeper for a boundary.
Length ball, on off, Mohammad Shahzad punches it to covers for a single.
Fuller again, around off, Mohammad Shahzad drives it through covers for a couple.

Update - As you are already aware, there are 2 more games that are going on simultaneously with this one. In the Group A game between Sri Lanka and Ireland, after a poor start by the Islanders, they are at 65/3 at the end of 8 overs. Lankans will be hoping that they keep building on. In the other warm-up game between Pakistan and South Africa, the former are at 59/2 in 9 overs, having lost Babar Azam and Rizwan and would be looking to consolidate.
On a length, angling away, Mohammad Shahzad pokes at it tentatively but the ball misses the outside edge of his blade.
FOUR! Lucky boundary for Mohammad Shahzad. Fuller again, outside off, Mohammad Shahzad goes chasing for that without any foot movement. Gets an outside edge wide of short third man for a boundary.
WIDE! Fuller, wide outside the off stump. Mohammad Shahzad looks to get a bat on that one but misses. Wide called.
Back of a length, on off, Hazratullah Zazai backs away and pulls it to long on for a single.
Length ball, around off, Hazratullah Zazai cuts it to point for a single.
Fuller, on the stumps, Mohammad Shahzad pushes it to mid on for a single.
Change. Obed McCoy comes back on. He gave away 15 in his first over.

FOUR! Little drama there!  Back of a length ball, outside off, Mohammad Shahzad first looks to back away but then sees the ball outside the off stump line and cuts. The fielder at deep point misfields and the ball goes past the boundary line.
Back of a length again, on off, Mohammad Shahzad pushes it off the back foot towards point.
Back of a length this time, Hazratullah Zazai pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, on the pads, Mohammad Shahzad clips it to backward square leg for a single.

SIX! High and handsome! Akeal Hosein gives this delivery some extra airtime, full and around off, Hazratullah Zazai gets down on one knee, manages to align himself and sends it rocketing it over the bowler's head for a maximum. At the end of the Powerplay, Afghanistan are 62/0.
Ravi Rampaul is into the attack!
Short and on middle, Shahzad pushes it firmly down to mid on. Andre Russell tries to stop it with his boot but deflects it away towards long off. Now, the batters cross.
This one is darted outside off, quick and slightly short, Zazai tries to fetch it from outside off to play the slog sweep but it takes the inner edge and runs in front of square leg for a single.
Fires it in, flat and short, around off, Zazai defends it from the back foot to extra cover.
Quicker again, short and on off, Shahzad moves back and forces it to long off for one.
Flatter delivery, short and on off, Shahzad cuts it from the back foot but finds the fielder at cover-point.
Quicker through the air, short and on off, Zazai gets back and punches it to cover-point. A dot ball to finish yet another expensive over.
FOUR! Fine footwork! Chase hurls it short and on middle, Hazratullah Zazai hops back to make room and whacks it through covers for a boundary. 50 up!
Floated and full around off, Hazratullah Zazai stays back and defends it to the off side, a bit uppish but safe.
FOUR! Up and over the infield. Short and outside off, Zazai rocks back to play a full-blooded square cut. It takes the top half of his bat and flies behind backward point for a boundary.
Gets forward and pushes it to covers.

Misfield! Chase delivers it slower through the air but the length is short and around middle, Hazratullah Zazai steps back to make room and slaps it towards covers. Andre Russell fails to make the stop and they take two.
Loopy and full, around off, Zazai gets down to slog-sweep but only manages to drag it off the inner edge. The ball dribbles to deep square leg and they cross. A tidy first over by Akeal Hosein!
Tossed up, full and around off, Shahzad drives it through wide mid off for a single.
Short and around off, Shahzad makes room but punches it straight to short cover.
Follows the batsman down the leg side with a quick short ball, Shahzad is cramped up and ends up defending it back to the bowler.
Play and a miss! Flighted and full outside off, Shahzad steps back to loft it over the infield on the off side but misses.
Flatter and on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Akeal Hosein, the replacement of Fabian Allen, gets his opportunity now. He comes into attack replacing Obed McCoy.
Tossed up and on middle, Hazratullah Zazai defends it down from the crease. Another expensive over for West Indies, 10 from it!
Flighted one, full and following the batsman down the leg side, Zazai plays late but only manages to deflect it straight to short third man.
FOUR! Hammered away! Another long hop from Chase, around middle, this time Hazratullah Zazai stands tall inside the crease and muscles it over square leg.
FOUR! Chase drags his length short and delivers it on middle and leg, Hazratullah Zazai kneels down and pulls it powerfully behind square leg for a boundary.
Tossed up and on middle, flicked on the leg side but not in the gap.

Roston Chase begins with a flatter short ball on middle and leg, Hazratullah Zazai gets down on one knee and drags his attempted sweep shot towards short fine leg. Oshane Thomas puts in a dive to take the pace off the ball and saves two runs.
Slightly short and around leg, angling down at a slower pace, Hazratullah Zazai swivels and pulls it behind square leg for one. 31 from two overs, Afghanistan are off to a flying start.
Roston Chase comes into the attack now.

Clever slower one to deceive the batsman. On a length around middle and leg, Zazai is early into his attempted slog-sweep and misses. Called a no ball though for overstepping. Another Free Hit coming...
Fuller and on off, bunted down to mid on for a quick run.

FOUR! Two shots from the edge of the bat and Mohammad Shahzad moves to 10. Short and wide outside off, Shahzad rocks back to slap it through the line but edges it past the diving keeper for a boundary at third man.
Slower one, full toss on middle, Hazratullah Zazai swings his bat at it, a bit early and drags it through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Brute power! Obed McCoy misses to nail his yorker by a fraction and it turns out to be a very full ball in the slot for the batsman, Hazratullah Zazai brings his bottom hand into the play and plays a short-arm jab over mid-wicket.
Wide! Another attempted slower one but this one goes as a full toss and down the leg side, Zazai tries to flick but misses.
Swing and a miss! Obed McCoy opts for the slower one, full and sliding down the leg side, Hazratullah Zazai swings his bat early and misses. It kisses his pads and goes to the keeper.
Now the bowler oversteps as he bowls a length ball on middle, Hazratullah Zazai defends it back. Free Hit loading...
Wide! Wrong start, serves a full ball down the leg side, Zazai tries flicking but misses.
Obed McCoy to bowl from the other end.

SIX! Mohammad Shahzad is away with a streaky biggie. Short in length and outside off, Shahzad flashes his bat at it and the top edge takes the ball over third man for a maximum. 16 from the first over, a good start for Afghanistan.
On a length around middle and leg, Hazratullah Zazai flicks it through square leg for a single.

FOUR! Edgy! Short again, outside off and angling away, Hazratullah Zazai stays back to pull but gets a thick outside edge. It doesn't carry to the keeper who dives across to his left and deflects it past first slip for a boundary.
Wide! Wayward delivery, short and down the leg side, Zazai tries to pull but misses.
Smell the leather! Oshane Thomas speeds in and digs in a short ball on middle, well-directed, Hazratullah Zazai keep his bat near his face as he sways away.
Back of a length, on off, Hazratullah Zazai tries to repeat the last shot but finds the backward point fielder on this occasion.
FOUR! PUT AWAY! Short in length and wide outside off, Zazai stays on the back foot and slaps it through point for a boundary. A good start for Afghanistan.

The game is set to begin. West Indies players are in a huddle, the skipper Kieron Pollard has the final words with his team. Mohammad Shahzad and Hazratullah Zazai to open the batting for Afghanistan. Oshane Thomas to start with the ball.

West Indies - Lendl Simmons, Andre Fletcher, Roston Chase, Shimron Hetmyer, Nicholas Pooran (WK), Kieron Pollard (C), Hayden Walsh, Ravi Rampaul, Obed McCoy, Oshane Thomas, Evin Lewis, Andre Russell, Dwayne Bravo, Akeal Hosein.

Afghanistan - Mohammad Shahzad (WK), Hazratullah Zazai, Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Karim Janat, Asghar Afghan, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi (C), Gulbadin Naib, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Naveen-ul-Haq, Hamid Hassan, Fareed Ahmad.
PITCH REPORT - VVS Laxman is up for the pitch report. He says it will be a good batting surface. Mentions dew will play a part here but in the second innings.
TOSS – The two skippers are out in the middle for the flip of the coin. The coin goes up and lands in favour of Afghanistan. They have opted to BAT first.

The major area where West Indies would look to improve will be their batting. So far, they have not clicked as a unit. Renowned for power-hitting, they would be hopeful of striking that devastating form before the mega event. Afghanistan, on their part, have the advantage of playing in favourable conditions but they too lack depth in both departments. They rely too heavily on a few individuals and need to find a balance not just in the team composition but also in performance.

Hello and welcome everyone for yet another warm-up game of this ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2021. The defending champions will be in action this evening against Afghanistan. Both teams didn't enjoy a good outing in their first practice game and would be looking to make amends. There is plenty of quality in both the camps but certainly West Indies are a better all-round team than Afghanistan. Can they play like one? Let's find out.
... WARM-UP TIME ...
